1.name: The Leader
1.shadow: Domineering, self-centered, impatient, lonely at the top.
1.in_love: Wants a partner who respects their autonomy; leads, but must learn to share the wheel.

2.name: The Diplomat
2.light: Cooperative, intuitive, gentle, a natural peacemaker.
2.in_love: Deeply devoted and attuned; thrives on closeness, needs reassurance.

3.name: The Communicator
3.in_love: Fun and affectionate; keeps things light, must learn to go deep.

4.name: The Builder
4.shadow: Rigid, stubborn, resistant to change, all work.
4.in_love: Steady and committed; shows love through dependability, not drama.

5.name: The Free Spirit
5.in_love: Exciting and spontaneous; needs space and novelty to stay.

6.name: The Nurturer
6.shadow: Self-sacrificing, controlling 'for your own good', martyr.
6.in_love: The caretaker of the relationship; gives generously, must avoid smothering.

7.name: The Seeker
7.shadow: Aloof, secretive, over-analytical, hard to reach.
7.in_love: Loves with depth but needs alone-time; intimacy grows through trust, slowly.

8.name: The Powerhouse
8.light: Driven, capable, resilient, a natural manager.
8.in_love: Provides and protects; must remember the relationship isn't a project to optimize.

9.name: The Humanitarian
9.light: Big-hearted, wise, tolerant, gives to the world.
9.shadow: Self-righteous, emotionally distant, can't let go.
9.in_love: Loves broadly and idealistically; must learn to receive, not only give.

11.name: The Intuitive (Master)
11.shadow: Anxious, high-strung, overwhelmed by their own sensitivity.
11.in_love: Intensely intuitive about a partner's needs; needs a calm, grounding presence.

22.name: The Master Builder
22.light: Turns big dreams into reality; practical visionary.
22.in_love: Builds a life and legacy with a partner; must not make love a deliverable.

33.name: The Master Teacher
33.light: Selfless, uplifting, deeply nurturing on a large scale.
33.shadow: Over-responsible for others, neglects own needs.
33.in_love: Loves through service and care; must let a partner carry them too.
